notes.title: Patch 1.07
notes.content:
- Fixed language in tutorial panel
- Fixed music volume set to 0 when starting for the first time
- Fixed negative gold

notes.title: Patch 1.06
notes.content:
- Fixed Masterslayer Achievement.

(If you already have defeated the boss you have to do it again with every character to unlock this achievement. Big sorry!)

notes.title: Patch 1.05
notes.content:
- Added spell costs to spell tree, so the player can see if it's worth to upgrade a spell
- Hide item and potion tooltip when spell tree is visible
- Added two-damage attack to crystal enemy to prevent an endless fight
- Potential fix for cards not turn up after a timebomb explosion (Please send me feedback, if this still occurs)
- Improved some tooltips on shop menu
- Fixed streak generates no gold after the last card gets destroyed

Known Bugs:
- Sometimes when two or more cards should get an status effect, only one card gets it.

notes.title: Patch 1.04
notes.content:
- Fixed wrong character selection after not clicking on the character button

Thanks to Oddy

notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.content: - Fixed unintentionally high spell cost for Holy Light

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
- Increased Protect cost from 1 to 2
- Increased Holy Light cost from 2 to 3
- increased Angels Kiss cost from 8 to 9
- Changed Vikings Loot spell tooltip, replaced - with +
- Fixed some spelling mistakes

Thanks to scootytheclown and Mark Alan for reporting.

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
- Fixed a spelling mistake in tutorial
- Fixed the text on a button after winning a fight
- Removed the empty black tooltip when hovering over cards without status effects

Thanks to User scootytheclown for reporting.
